about: Per sample, per property: the least share of elements that must match the source program's drawing in what graphty-element is asked to draw (test/fidelity/scorecard.test.ts). Floors only rise; record them with GRAPHTY_FIDELITY_RECORD=1, which raises each floor to the score measured, never lowers one and keeps the samples it did not run. A drop accepted below a floor is listed in `allowedDrops` with the rate accepted (`to`); a score below `to` fails. A property no longer judged at all is taken off its floors and listed in `retired` with its reason.
